name: What is the average cost to tile a bathroom in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to tile a bathroom in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to tile a bathroom in the Bay Area can vary significantly due to factors like labor rates, tile material choices, and project scope. On average, homeowners might expect to pay between $10 to $25 per square foot for basic tile and installation. However, for premium tiles, complex layouts, or specialized waterproofing, costs can exceed $30-$50 per square foot. This estimate typically covers materials, labor, and basic preparation. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate cost for your specific project.
